title: lax functor
why_consulted: DAG vol1 ch11 附录 A 用非一元右松弛函子 S⇝RLax_non-untl(S) 及其万有性（定理 A.1.5），需核对 nLab 关于 lax functor 与 2-范畴间松弛函子的约定
definition_zh: 松弛函子是 $n$-范畴之间的态射，其复合子（compositor）、结合子等结构胞不必可逆，甚至不必弱可逆；这与所有结构胞都是等价的伪函子形成对照。按结构胞定向的不同，还有反松弛（oplax）函子。DAG 第 11 章附录 A 使用非一元右松弛函子 $\mathbb{S}\rightsquigarrow\RLax_{\text{non-untl}}(\mathbb{S})$，并证明它是万有的（定理 A.1.5）。
key_points: 结构胞只需存在，不要求可逆；结构胞的方向决定 lax 与 oplax
伪函子 = 所有结构胞都可逆的松弛函子
非一元（non-unital）版本不要求保持恒等态射，DAG 用它构造万有右松弛函子
DAG ch11 附录 A：$\iota_{\mathbb{S}}:\mathbb{S}\rightsquigarrow\RLax_{\text{non-untl}}(\mathbb{S})$ 与 $\lambda_{\mathbb{S}}$ 分别是伴随的单位与余单位
idea_original: A lax functor or lax nn-functor is a morphism of nn-categories that is allowed to have structural cells – compositors, associators, etc – that need not be invertible (not even weakly). This is to distinguish from pseudofunctor for which all these cells are required to be equivalences. This means that the definition of lax functor involves a choice of orientation of these structural cells which is not visible for pseudofunctors. The choice is such that cells map composites of images to images of composite. With the opposite choice one speaks of an oplax (or sometimes colax) functor. The term lax functor can be used for nn-functors F:C→DF : C \to D whose domain CC is an ordinary category (regarded as an nn-category with only trivial higher morphisms), while the codomain DD is often taken to be a 2-category. A normal lax functor (sometimes called strictly unitary) preserves identities strictly. There exist a similar concept for double and multiple categories.
references: R. Street, Two constructions on lax functors, Cahiers de Topologie et Géométrie Différentielle Catégoriques, Volume 13 (1972) no. 3 , p. 217-264 numdam
our_term: 松弛函子；右松弛函子（right-lax functor）
used_in: vol1 ch11 附录 A（定理 A.1.5、命题 A.1.7）
